import socket, time
s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
s.connect('/tmp/qemu-monitor.sock')
time.sleep(0.3)
s.recv(4096)
s.sendall(b'info status\n')
time.sleep(0.3)
print(s.recv(4096).decode(errors='replace'))
s.sendall(b'screendump /tmp/qemu-screen5.ppm\n')

print(s.recv(4096).decode(errors='replace'))

python3 -c "
with open('/tmp/qemu-screen5.ppm','rb') as f:
    f.readline()
    dims = f.readline().strip()
    f.readline()
    data = f.read()
    w, h = map(int, dims.split())
    non_black = sum(1 for i in range(0, len(data), 3) if data[i] > 30 or data[i+1] > 30 or data[i+2] > 30)
